improvements.change: pairing is a multiset match: every exact fingerprint match is made first across all findings, then the scope level on what remains, then the route level

the spec names reasons as untrusted text because paths are the repository's; each path is capped at 120 characters and passed through printable, and the document lists which of its fields hold repository text
the compile set is every program file the patch changed plus every program whose resolved COPYs include a changed file
G-I6 holds when both scans are complete; an incomplete scan is undecided whichever way it falls, so the verdict can move only between undecided and the complete answer
--exit-code: exit 0 on pass, 1 on fail, 3 on undecided; 2 stays could-not-run. Without it, exit 0 whenever the gate ran
gone-unexplained names its commonest cause: a route cut between source and sink, which the gate cannot place because trace hops carry no line; its reason says a person decides and why
G1.8's witness is the MOVE between source and sink deleted; G2.6's is a copybook the program copies removed (measured: coverageIncomplete true, compile set kind coverage)
the document says which pairing level found the target in the head: pairedBy fingerprint, scope or route
the scan carries the flow engine's sink and source listings when asked, so a gate runs two flow analyses rather than four
